unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We all laughed a lot watching the funny comedy at the theater.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们在戏院看那部有趣的喜剧时笑得很开心。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音“烤梅底”——在喜剧结尾大家一起烤着梅子庆祝，充满欢乐。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Revise your draft according to your partner's comments.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 网络常用：在网络上发表“评论”常用 comment 这个词。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` (1) 交流，交际；(2) 表达；传达
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Another interesting thing about bees is how they communicate.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆: 在社区 (community) 里，大家需要友好交流 (communicate)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We are in communication by email.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：communicate（交流）的名词形式，-tion是常见名词后缀。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: You and your classmates want to help clean up the community.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 共同(com)联合(muni)的体(ty)系就是社区。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: 79-year-old Hiroshi competed at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：com（共同）+ pete（追求/寻找） -> 共同追求，即“竞争；参加比赛”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She won first place in the national English speech competition.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 她获得了全国英语演讲比赛的第一名。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 来自动词compete（竞争），后缀-ition构成名词。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: There were ten strong competitors in the final running race.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 在最后的赛跑中有十位强劲的对手。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: compete（竞争）+ -itor（表人的后缀，指竞争者）。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 抱怨，诉苦；投诉；疾病
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The hotel manager dealt with the customer's complaint politely.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 酒店经理礼貌地处理了顾客的投诉。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 来自complain（抱怨），把t去掉加-t变成名词形式。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Beethoven is a world-famous German composer.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 贝多芬是一位世界闻名的德国作曲家。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: compose（作曲）+ -er（人）= 作曲家。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 与……有关 v. (1) 使担忧；使挂念；(2) 涉及，影响；(3) 与……有关
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Environmental protection is a matter of global concern.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 环境保护是一个全球关心的问题。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: con（共同）+ cern（筛子）→ 大家共同筛选关心的事→ 关心、涉及。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What conclusion can we draw from the experiment?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 短语搭配: draw a conclusion (得出结论)；con- (共同) + clud (关闭) -> 最终定案就是结论。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: v. 进行，实施；指挥 n. 行为，举止
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The scientist will conduct an experiment in the lab tomorrow.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 这位科学家明天将在实验室进行一项实验。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: con（全部）+ duct（引导）→ 全面引导、实施、指挥。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I have confidence in you.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀：con（共同）+ fid（相信）+ ence（名词后缀）= 信心。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I feel much more confident than I felt this morning.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀：con（共同）+ fid（相信）+ ent = 自信的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Please check your email for the flight booking confirmation.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 请检查您的电子邮件以查看航班预订确认单。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: confirm（确认）+ -ation（名词后缀）→ 确认书。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The similar spellings of these two words always confuse me.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 这两个词相似的拼写总是让我迷惑。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: con（一起）+ fuse（熔化）→ 把不同的东西熔到一起分不清→ 使混淆。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Congratulations on winning the prize at the school music festival!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：con(共同)+grat(感激/开心)+ulation(名词后缀)→大家聚在一起表达开心→“祝贺”

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I'd like some time to consider.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：con（共同）+ sid（坐）+ er -> 大家坐在一起共同商量，即“仔细考虑”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Modern companies should always put consumers' needs first.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 现代企业应该始终把消费者的需求放在首位。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: consume（消费）+ -er（人）= 消费者。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Keep the leftover soup in an airtight plastic container.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 把剩下的汤放在密封的塑料容器里。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: contain（包含）+ -er（物）→ 能容纳东西的器具→ 容器。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 竞争，比赛 v. 争取赢得(比赛、选举等)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Our school holds an annual singing contest in May.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们学校在五月份举办年度歌唱比赛。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: con（共同）+ test（测试、考验）→ 大家聚在一起比拼→ 竞赛。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Every contestant tried their best to win the game show.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 每位参赛者都竭尽全力去赢得这个游戏节目。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: contest（比赛）+ -ant（人）= 参赛者。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: v. 控制 n. 控制能力
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It is important for drivers to control their speed on rainy days.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 雨天驾驶员控制好车速是很重要的。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音“抗戳”——能够对抗并戳住局面，就是“控制”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It is very convenient and doesn't cost much money.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆: con(共同) + ven(来) -> 大家都能来 -> 方便的

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: This is a private conversation!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 大家一起(con)转向(vers)行动，通过谈话(conversation)达成一致。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We need to cooperate with each other to finish the project on time.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们需要互相合作才能按时完成这个项目。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: co-（共同）+ operate（操作、运转）→ 共同运转→ 合作。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Fishermen along the river use trained cormorants to catch fish.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 江边的渔民用训练有素的鸬鹚来捕鱼。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想：cormo（形似corm根茎）+ rant（大叫）→ 在水面上捕鱼的鸬鹚。
